body: I stand frozen at the door, my eyes scanning the room as I try to recall the events of the night. The familiar scent of disinfectant fills my nostrils, reminding me of the lab's meticulous routines. A faint trail of footprints on the floor leads me to the wastebasket, where a few drops of blood stain the already messy surface. My mind racing with questions, I decide to confront the person responsible directly.
